nodes.name: Gmail Trigger
nodes.notes: SETUP: Connect your Gmail OAuth2 credentials. Polls every 5 minutes for unread emails.

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "model": "claude-haiku-4-5-20241022",
  "max_tokens": 512,
  "system": "You are a family email classifier. Analyze this email and extract relevant information for a busy parent. Respond with ONLY a JSON object (no markdown, no code blocks) with these fields:
- summary: 1-2 sentence summary
- category: one of [school, sports, medical, family, work, social, bills, spam]
- priority: one of [high, medium, low]
- has_event: boolean - does this contain a date/time event?
- event_details: if has_event is true, object with {title, date, time, location}
- has_action_item: boolean - does this require a response or action?
- action_item: if has_action_item is true, brief description of what's needed
- notify_josh: boolean - should the co-parent be notified about this?",
  "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": {{ JSON.stringify($json.promptText) }}}]
}

nodes.name: Format SMS Message
nodes.notes: SETUP: Replace YOUR_PHONE_NUMBER with your actual phone number (e.g., +15551234567)

nodes.name: Send SMS via Twilio
nodes.notes: SETUP: Replace YOUR_TWILIO_PHONE_NUMBER with your Twilio number (e.g., +15551234567)
